text: dsh-model-thinking（DSH 插件，Desktop 和 Web 客户端）：为第三方 OpenAI 兼容模型补充思考强度选项。它在 DSH 的模型配置处理中叠加能力信息，让原生 Effort 菜单显示匹配档位。主要功能包括按已安装目录匹配模型、为网关配置档位覆盖、为未知 GPT 型号设置显式默认档位，并在停用时恢复原配置。适合使用兼容模型并希望按模型选择推理强度的 DSH 用户。无需额外账号或在线服务，自动匹配读取本地能力目录。

dsh-model-thinking (DSH Desktop and Web) adds reasoning effort choices for third-party OpenAI-compatible models. It matches the local catalog and supports gateway overrides and fallback levels, restoring original configuration when disabled. For DSH users who want per-model reasoning controls.
想让第三方 OpenAI 兼容模型也能选择思考强度
DSH 的 Effort 菜单能按当前模型显示不同档位吗

切换模型时自动调整可用的 reasoning effort

Map gateway model names to custom effort values in DSH
dsh-model-thinking 的功能「按模型匹配档位」：插件读取 DSH 随附的模型能力目录，按提供商和模型 ID 查找推理等级，并在切换已配置模型时呈现对应选项。未知或歧义型号不会被自动猜测。
dsh-model-thinking 的功能「网关档位覆盖」：用户可配置 provider 与 model 匹配规则，为指定网关模型映射菜单档位到请求参数值，也可用 null 表示省略 off 参数。规则优先于自动目录匹配。
dsh-model-thinking 的功能「动态叠加并恢复能力」：插件为兼容 API 的模型配置补充 reasoningEfforts，不改写原始配置；启用或卸载时刷新适配器，停用后恢复原能力声明。
dsh-model-thinking 使用本地能力目录匹配模型，不会实时探测网关；未知型号默认不推测档位，网关也可能不转发对应参数。

text:
dsh-model-thinking README · 简介：**根据接入的第三方模型自动匹配思考强度档位；切换或新增模型时，动态显示各自可用的等级。**

插件按提供商和模型 ID 读取 DSH 随包能力目录，让第三方 OpenAI 兼容模型直接使用原生思考强度菜单，也支持针对中转覆盖档位和参数值。这里的自动匹配依据本地目录，不会实时探测中转接口；未知型号默认不猜档位。

可以独立使用；搭配 [dsh-codex-effort-slider](https://github.com/Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider)，菜单会以带渐变、粒子和动画的滑条呈现。已在 DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` 验证。
dsh-model-thinking README · 目录：- [安装与使用](#use) - [搭配炫酷滑条](#slider) - [配置](#configuration) - [实现与开发](#development) - [相关项目](#related) - [模型交互](#model-experience) - [已知限制](#limitations) -----

dsh-model-thinking README · 安装与使用：从 [Releases](https://github.com/yxccai/dsh-model-thinking/releases) 下载 `dsh-model-thinking-0.2.0.tgz`。在 DSH Desktop 的插件管理中添加这个本地安装包，然后完全退出并重新打开 DSH。它是独立插件，无需安装滑条插件。 点击聊天输入框里的模型名称 → 思考强度（Effort）→ 选择档位。选择应用于下一次请求；使用原生菜单就能调第三方模型的强度。 截图来自隔离的 DSH Web profile，模型名为本地测试别名，请求只发送到本机模拟网关。桌面版复用同一套模型菜单。 安装会增加 `dsh-model-thinking` profile 层。禁用或卸载后，模型恢复原先声明的能力；已有会话选过的档位仍由 DSH 保存，需要时选择 Default。插件只叠加运行时能力配置，不改写提供商配置文件、API 密钥或会话历史。 -----

dsh-model-thinking README · 搭配炫酷滑条：希望操作更直观、界面更美观，可以另外安装 [Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider](https://github.com/Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider)。它为原生思考强度选择器增加拖动滑条、渐变配色和星尘动画；安装方法以该项目说明为准。 | 插件 | 负责什么 | | --- | --- | | `dsh-model-thinking`（本项目） | 补全第三方模型支持的档位，提供中转参数覆盖规则。 | | `dsh-codex-effort-slider`（可选） | 读取 DSH 已有档位，以带动画的滑条显示并操作。 | 两者是独立插件，没有合并，也没有强制依赖。本插件补全档位后，滑条会读取这些档位；仅保留本插件时，仍可使用 DSH 原生菜单。 已与滑条插件 `1.1.3` 联合验证五档和六档模型。截图中的滑条及视觉特效来自该项目，本仓库不包含它的代码。 -----

dsh-model-thinking README · 配置：默认启用自动匹配，无需手动填写档位。优先级是：模型显式声明（含禁用）→ 首条匹配的覆盖规则 → DSH 内置目录 → 显式设置的未知 GPT 回退档位。只补充缺少 `reasoningEfforts` 的 `models` 或 `modelOverrides`，支持 `openai-completions` 和 `openai-responses`。

需要为中转定制时，在所用 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中添加：

```yaml
- id: dsh-model-thinking
  config:
    autoCatalog: true
    defaultEfforts: []

`provider` 和 `model` 支持 `*` 通配符；`max: ultra` 仅是中转自定义参数的示例，只有中转要求 `ultra` 时才这样设置。规则值是实际发送的字符串，界面档位名可用 `off`、`minimal`、`low`、`medium`、`high`、`xhigh`、`max`。

dsh-model-thinking README · 配置：| 设置 | 含义 | | --- | --- | | `autoCatalog` | 默认 `true`；从当前 DSH 随包目录匹配模型能力，下次启动读取已升级的目录。 | | `defaultEfforts` | 默认 `[]`；仅为未知 GPT 型号显式配置回退档位，不是自动探测结果。 | | `rules` | 默认 `[]`；按提供商和模型匹配档位及其请求参数值。 | | `autoGpt` | 兼容旧配置的开关；设置后优先于 `autoCatalog`。 | `off: none` 明确发送 `none`；`off: null` 表示省略参数，不保证关闭思考。界面的 Default 沿用中转默认值，也不等于关闭思考。模型自身的 `reasoningEfforts: false` 和有效的 `supportsReasoningEffort: false` 保持优先。 -----

dsh-model-thinking README · 实现与开发：需要 Node.js `>=22.19.0`。从源码构建：

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run check
npm test
npm run build

15 项单元测试覆盖目录匹配、五档与六档、未知型号、显式禁用、覆盖优先级和配置不可变性。GitHub Actions 执行类型检查、单元测试、构建和打包。

<details>
<summary>实现与本地集成测试</summary>

[cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml) 插入一个宿主插件；[src/index.ts](src/index.ts) 为 pi-ai 适配器的有效配置叠加能力声明。[src/catalog.ts](src/catalog.ts) 读取当前安装的 pi-ai 内置模型目录；[src/capabilities.ts](src/capabilities.ts) 处理优先级和映射。插件不包含客户端界面，档位保存和请求序列化仍由 DSH 负责。

dsh-model-thinking README · 实现与开发：`scripts/test-installed.mjs` 使用真实 Loader、LLM 服务和 pi-ai 适配器，验证请求参数、配置更新、卸载恢复及已准备请求。`scripts/test-web.mjs` 启动隔离的真实 Web profile，用系统 Edge 检查原生菜单、滑条及提交参数。它们需要本机安装的 DSH，不在通用 CI 中运行，也不调用付费模型。 两个脚本的首个参数为安装包的 `app.asar/dsh` 目录，需要使用桌面版 Electron 的 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 模式执行。Web 测试支持 `DSH_TEST_MODEL`、`DSH_TEST_EFFORT`、`DSH_TEST_SLIDER_PATH` 和 `DSH_TEST_PLUGIN_PATH` 环境变量；目前五档/六档断言使用脚本中指定的测试型号。 -----

dsh-model-thinking README · 相关项目：- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)：宿主应用。 - [dsh-codex-effort-slider](https://github.com/Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider)：可选的滑条与视觉效果插件。 - [MIT License](LICENSE) 与 [第三方许可](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。
dsh-model-thinking README · 模型交互：本插件不添加工具、系统提示词或模型调用。它通过 DSH 现有路径传递所选推理强度；Chat Completions 和 Responses 的序列化由 pi-ai 适配器负责。

dsh-model-thinking README · 已知限制：自动匹配是读取本地能力目录，不是向中转实时询问档位。未知或存在歧义的型号默认不增加档位；目录中的能力不能保证中转完整转发参数，特殊限制需要覆盖规则。模型改名、使用别名或目录过旧时，也可能无法自动匹配。

已验证运行时为 DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2`，兼容性仍受其 Cordis、pi-ai 导出和配置机制影响。其他 DSH 版本需另行验证。插件启用和禁用会重新加载 pi-ai 适配器；已经准备好的请求保留开始时的参数。

text:
dsh-model-thinking README · Summary：**Automatically match reasoning-effort levels to connected third-party models, adapting the available options when you switch or add models.**

Provider and model IDs are matched against DSH's bundled catalog to enable native effort controls for third-party OpenAI-compatible models, with gateway-specific overrides. Matching uses local metadata, not live gateway probing; unknown models receive no guessed levels.

dsh-model-thinking README · Summary：Use it independently, or pair it with [dsh-codex-effort-slider](https://github.com/Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider) for a slider with gradients, particles, and animations. Verified with DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2`.

dsh-model-thinking README · Contents：- [Install and use](#use) - [Pair with the visual slider](#slider) - [Configuration](#configuration) - [Implementation and development](#development) - [Related projects](#related) - [Model experience](#model-experience) - [Known limitations](#limitations) -----

dsh-model-thinking README · Install and use：Download `dsh-model-thinking-0.2.0.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/yxccai/dsh-model-thinking/releases). Add this local package through DSH Desktop's plugin manager, then fully exit and reopen DSH. This is a standalone plugin; the slider plugin is optional.

Click the model name in the chat composer → Effort → select a level. Your selection applies to the next request; the native menu supports third-party models without a slider.

dsh-model-thinking README · Install and use：The screenshot comes from an isolated DSH Web profile using a local test alias. Requests only reach a local mock gateway. Desktop uses the same model menu.

Installation adds the `dsh-model-thinking` profile layer. Disabling or removing it restores the original declared capabilities; DSH retains effort selections in existing sessions, so select Default when necessary. The plugin overlays runtime capabilities without rewriting provider configuration files, API keys, or session history.

-----
dsh-model-thinking README · Install and use：

dsh-model-thinking README · Pair with the visual slider：For a more visual control, optionally install [Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider](https://github.com/Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider). It adds a draggable slider, gradient colors, and stardust animations to the native effort selector. Follow that project's installation instructions.

dsh-model-thinking README · Pair with the visual slider：| Plugin | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-model-thinking` (this project) | Fill in missing third-party model effort levels and provide gateway parameter overrides. |
| `dsh-codex-effort-slider` (optional) | Read existing DSH effort levels and display an animated slider to select them. |

These are separate plugins, with no merged code or required dependency. The slider reads the levels supplied by this plugin; using this plugin alone retains the native DSH menu.

dsh-model-thinking README · Pair with the visual slider：Five-level and six-level models were tested together with slider version `1.1.3`. The slider and visual effects in the screenshot belong to that project; its code is not included here. -----

dsh-model-thinking README · Configuration：Automatic matching is enabled by default. Precedence is: explicit model declaration (including opt-out) → first matching override rule → installed DSH catalog → explicitly configured fallback for unknown GPT IDs. Only missing `reasoningEfforts` in `models` or `modelOverrides` are enriched, for `openai-completions` and `openai-responses` routes.

To customize a gateway, add this to the active profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

dsh-model-thinking README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: dsh-model-thinking
  config:
    autoCatalog: true
    defaultEfforts: []

`provider` and `model` support `*` wildcards. `max: ultra` is only an example of a gateway-specific wire value; use it only when your gateway requires `ultra`. Values are the strings sent in requests. Selector level names are `off`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, and `max`.

dsh-model-thinking README · Configuration：| Setting | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `autoCatalog` | Default `true`; match the installed DSH catalog, reading an upgraded catalog on the next startup. |
| `defaultEfforts` | Default `[]`; explicitly set fallback levels for unknown GPT IDs, rather than detected capabilities. |
| `rules` | Default `[]`; match a provider/model pair to effort levels and request parameter values. |
| `autoGpt` | Legacy compatibility switch; takes precedence over `autoCatalog` when set. |

dsh-model-thinking README · Configuration：`off: none` explicitly sends `none`; `off: null` omits the parameter and does not guarantee disabled reasoning. Default in the menu uses the gateway default and also does not mean disabled reasoning. Model-level `reasoningEfforts: false` and an effective `supportsReasoningEffort: false` remain authoritative. -----

dsh-model-thinking README · Implementation and development：Requires Node.js `>=22.19.0`. Build from source:

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run check
npm test
npm run build

The 15 unit tests cover catalog matching, five/six levels, unknown IDs, explicit opt-outs, override precedence, and configuration immutability. GitHub Actions runs type checks, unit tests, the build, and packaging.

<details>
<summary>Implementation and local integration tests</summary>

dsh-model-thinking README · Implementation and development：[cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml) inserts a host plugin. [src/index.ts](src/index.ts) overlays capability declarations onto the pi-ai adapter's effective configuration. [src/catalog.ts](src/catalog.ts) reads the installed pi-ai catalog; [src/capabilities.ts](src/capabilities.ts) handles precedence and mappings. There is no client UI bundle; DSH still owns effort persistence and request serialization.

dsh-model-thinking README · Implementation and development：`scripts/test-installed.mjs` uses the real Loader, LLM service, and pi-ai adapter to verify request parameters, configuration updates, unload restoration, and prepared calls. `scripts/test-web.mjs` boots an isolated real Web profile and uses system Edge to check the native menu, slider, and submitted parameters. They require a local DSH installation, are excluded from generic CI, and make no paid model calls.

dsh-model-thinking README · Implementation and development：Both scripts take the installed `app.asar/dsh` directory as their first argument and run under Desktop Electron with `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`. The Web test accepts `DSH_TEST_MODEL`, `DSH_TEST_EFFORT`, `DSH_TEST_SLIDER_PATH`, and `DSH_TEST_PLUGIN_PATH`; its five/six-level assertions currently use the fixture model IDs specified in the script. -----

dsh-model-thinking README · Related projects：- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): the host application. - [dsh-codex-effort-slider](https://github.com/Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider): optional slider and visual effects. - [MIT License](LICENSE) and [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

dsh-model-thinking README · Model experience：This plugin adds no tools, system prompts, or model calls. It passes the selected reasoning effort through the existing DSH path; the pi-ai adapter serializes Chat Completions and Responses requests.

dsh-model-thinking README · Known limitations：Automatic matching reads a local capability catalog rather than querying a gateway for its live capabilities. Unknown or ambiguous model IDs receive no extra levels by default. Catalog metadata cannot guarantee that a gateway forwards all parameters; use override rules for gateway-specific restrictions. Renamed models, aliases, and stale catalogs can also prevent matching.

dsh-model-thinking README · Known limitations：The verified runtime is DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2`. Compatibility depends on its Cordis configuration mechanism and pi-ai exports; other DSH versions require separate verification. Enabling or disabling the plugin reloads the pi-ai adapter. Prepared requests retain the parameters from when they started.
